title: Port Varen Lanterns
description: Northern Hockey League team in Port Varen
extract: The Port Varen Lanterns are a professional ice hockey team based in Port Varen. The Lanterns compete in the Northern Hockey League as a member of the Harbour Division. The team plays its home games at Breakwater Garden.
